'''Alfredo Noel Iusem''' (born 10 November 1949, in [[Buenos Aires]]) is an [[Argentina|Argentine]]-born [[Brazil]]ian [[mathematician]] working on [[mathematical optimization]].<ref name="ABC">{{Cite web |url=http://www.abc.org.br/resultado.php3?codigo=aniusem |title=Academia Brasileira de Ciências |access-date=2015-05-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150522111218/http://www.abc.org.br/resultado.php3?codigo=aniusem |archive-date=2015-05-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He earned his Ph.D. from [[Stanford University]] in 1981 under the supervision of [[George Bernard Dantzig]].<ref name="MG">{{MathGenealogy|id=58755}}</ref>

He is a recipient of [[National Order of Scientific Merit (Brazil)|Brazil's National Order of Scientific Merit]] in mathematics.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mct.gov.br/index.php/content/view/11199/11199.html?nome=&area=Ci%EAncias+Matem%E1ticas&classificacao=&categoria=vivo|archive-url=https://archive.today/20150418134045/http://www.mct.gov.br/index.php/content/view/11199/11199.html?nome=&area=Ci%EAncias+Matem%E1ticas&classificacao=&categoria=vivo|url-status=dead|archive-date=2015-04-18|title=Portal do Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação|work=mct.gov.br}}</ref> Since 2001, he has been a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="ABC"/>

[[Regina Burachik]] was a student of his at [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada]].<ref name="MG" />
